# Rounding pi to the nearest 2dp.
```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

# Sequences
```{r}
print(seq(1, 10, 2))
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))
```

# Repeating values
```{r}
print(rep(2, 5))
print(rep(x = 2, times = 5))
print(rep(5,7))
```

# Variable types
Numeric
```{r}
a <- 2026
print(a)
```
Character
```{r}
b <- "Batesian mimicry"
print(b)
```
Logical 
```{r}
c <- TRUE
print(c)
```
Identifying types of variables
```{r}
print(class(a))
print(class(b))
print(class(c))
```
#Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123

num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```

#Behaviour of R
```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5 + TRUE)
#TRUE = 1 and FALSE = 0
```
```{r}
x <- NA
print(x == NA)
print(is.na(x))
#NA is a missing or unknown value
```
```{r}
x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))
#NaN is Not a Number
#is.na() checks whether a value is missing
```

```{r}
print(round(2.5))
print(round(3.5))
#R rounds to even
```
